name: Shinonome Mikako
source:
School counselor and “Shuuta's” older sister.  She appears optimistic and hedonistic, but in fact she is calm and collected. She has a keen sense of observation.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_065.html#character]official site[/url]]
